narrative.details: Here... take... <hic> this to Jediga. Good luck to ya!
narrative.objectives: Deliver Andron's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Perfect... wait a minute.

Haha! What'd you tell him when you delivered the tablet, adventurer? He overpaid us way too much! Not that I'm complaining. Did you tell him the deal changed? Or was he drunk again?

Doesn't matter... here, take an extra share also.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you met with Andron yet? He rarely leaves Undercity, so I don't think it'd be too hard to find him.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 52, 11,450 XP in all.

quests.name: Stealing Knowledge
quests.objectiveText: Find the Tablet of Beth'Amara, the Tablet of Jin'yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael'hai before returning to Jediga in Azshara.

quests.name: Delivery to Andron Gant
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Tablet of Markri to Andron Gant in Undercity.
